title: How long until local AI pays for itself? — Sunk Cost
excerpt: Which open models fit your machine, how fast they run, and how many tokens it takes to pay back the hardware against an API. Honest enough to say never.
content_html:
Assumptions you can change

Your own machine, speed and bill are sent to us once you stop typing, with no cookies and no IP address, only the country the request came from, so the options and estimates can get better. Browsers set not to be tracked send nothing.

Where nothing has been measured, local speed is estimated as memory bandwidth ÷ bytes read per token × , and labelled as such. API speed only affects the time comparison.
